context:
Goal: the Duo design warns about lost mail at the right time.
Problem: the blind mockups assumed a 28-day claim window. The app already rules 30 days from the order date. No feed gives a delivery date, so the order date stays the clock.
Meanwhile: manifest-duo waits for item 11.

options.gain: One rule across web, phone and Duo.
options.how: The Duo uses the existing 30-day rule.
options.label: Reuse 30 days
Use 28 days
options.lose: The Duo disagrees with the web and phone.

ref: Duo concepts PR #139; record lost-mail-flags-use-order-date (when lost-mail warnings start)
title: Duo: which claim deadline should the Duo design use?
why: One rule everywhere; 28 was only the designer's assumption.
